title.tr: Ne yapacaksın? θα ile gelecek zaman
title.en: What will you do? The future with θα

blocks.tr:
Bu bölümde **ne yapacağını** söylemeyi öğreneceksin: plan yapmak, randevu almak, birini geziye çağırmak ve "gelebilir misin?" diye sormak.

Anahtar nokta: Yunanca gelecek zaman, fiilin önüne **θα** koyarak kurulur. Türkçedeki *-ecek* eki gibi düşün. Ama bir şey daha var: fiilin kökü de değişir. *γράφω* "yazıyorum" olur, *θα γράψω* "yazacağım" demek.
blocks.en:
In this chapter you learn to say **what you will do**: make plans and appointments, invite someone on a trip, ask "can you come?".

The key point: the future is **θα** + the verb, like English *will*, but the verb's stem changes too: *γράφω* "I write", *θα γράψω* "I will write".

blocks.tr: Bu hafta sonu ne yapacaksın? Biriyle buluşacak mısın? Bir yere gidecek misin? Bölümün sonunda bunu Yunanca söyleyebileceksin.
blocks.en: What are you doing this weekend? Are you meeting someone? Going somewhere? By the end of this chapter you can say it in Greek.

blocks.tr: Önce dinle, sonra oku. **θα** sözcüğünü ve onu izleyen fiilleri izle: *θα πάω*, *θα τηλεφωνήσω*, *θα έρθω*.
blocks.en: Listen first, then read. Watch **θα** and the verbs after it: *θα πάω*, *θα τηλεφωνήσω*, *θα έρθω*.

setting.tr: Çarşamba akşamı, merdivende. Giorgos Zeynep'i çağırıyor.
setting.en: Wednesday evening, on the stairs. Giorgos invites Zeynep.

lines.el: Γεια σου, Ζεϊνέπ! Το Σάββατο θα πάω στη Χαλκιδική. Θέλεις να έρθεις;
lines.tr: Merhaba Zeynep! Cumartesi Halkidiki'ye gideceğim. Gelmek ister misin?
lines.en: Hi, Zeynep! On Saturday I'm going to Halkidiki. Would you like to come?

lines.el: Στη Χαλκιδική; Ναι, θέλω! Αλλά το Σάββατο το πρωί έχω ραντεβού με τον γιατρό.
lines.tr: Halkidiki'ye mi? Evet, isterim! Ama cumartesi sabahı doktorla randevum var.
lines.en: To Halkidiki? Yes, I'd love to! But on Saturday morning I have an appointment with the doctor.
Can you phone the doctor's office?

setting.tr: Telefonda, resmî. Zeynep doktorun muayenehanesini arıyor.
setting.en: On the phone, formal. Zeynep calls the doctor's office.

lines.el: Καλημέρα σας. Με λένε Ζεϊνέπ. Έχω ραντεβού το Σάββατο στις εννιά, αλλά δεν μπορώ να έρθω.
lines.tr: Günaydın. Adım Zeynep. Cumartesi saat dokuzda randevum var ama gelemiyorum.
lines.en: Good morning. My name is Zeynep. I have an appointment on Saturday at nine, but I can't come.

lines.el: Μεθαύριο, την Παρασκευή, δεν έχουμε ελεύθερο ραντεβού. Την επόμενη εβδομάδα, τη Δευτέρα στις δέκα;
lines.tr: Öbür gün, cuma günü boş randevumuz yok. Önümüzdeki hafta, pazartesi saat onda olur mu?
lines.en: The day after tomorrow, on Friday, we have no free appointment. Next week, Monday at ten?

lines.el: Ναι, ωραία. Θα έρθω τη Δευτέρα στις δέκα. Ευχαριστώ πολύ.
lines.tr: Evet, güzel. Pazartesi saat onda geleceğim. Çok teşekkürler.
lines.en: Yes, fine. I'll come on Monday at ten. Thank you very much.

setting.tr: Zeynep Giorgos'u arıyor; birlikte planı yapıyorlar.
setting.en: Zeynep calls Giorgos; together they make the plan.

lines.el: Γιώργο, μπορώ να έρθω! Θα πάω στον γιατρό τη Δευτέρα.
lines.en: Giorgos, I can come! I'll see the doctor on Monday.

lines.el: Στις οχτώ; Θα ξυπνήσω νωρίς! Θα πάμε με το λεωφορείο;
lines.tr: Sekizde mi? Erken kalkacağım! Otobüsle mi gideceğiz?
lines.en: At eight? I'll have to get up early! Shall we go by bus?

lines.el: Όχι, θα πάμε με το αυτοκίνητο. Έχω αυτοκίνητο.
lines.en: No, we'll go by car. I have a car.

lines.el: Εγώ θα αγοράσω τυρόπιτες στον φούρνο. Εσύ μπορείς να πάρεις φρούτα;
lines.tr: Ben fırından peynirli börek alacağım. Sen meyve alabilir misin?
lines.en: I'll buy cheese pies at the bakery. Can you get some fruit?

lines.el: Ίσως θέλει και ο Μάρκο να έρθει μαζί.
lines.tr: Belki Marko da birlikte gelmek ister.
lines.en: Maybe Marko would like to come along too.

lines.el: Θα είναι μια ωραία εκδρομή στη θάλασσα!
lines.en: It will be a lovely trip to the sea!

picture_alt.tr: Cumartesi sabahı: Giorgos peynirli börekleri arabaya koyuyor; Zeynep elmalarla geliyor; Marko el sallıyor.
picture_alt.en: Saturday morning: Giorgos puts the cheese pies in the car; Zeynep comes with the apples; Marko waves.

blocks.tr: Yeni birkaç kelime: [[η Χαλκιδική]] Selanik'in yakınındaki yarımada, [[το ιατρείο]] "muayenehane", [[η γραμματέας]] "sekreter", [[το αυτοκίνητο]] "araba", [[τώρα]] "şimdi", [[τα μήλα]] "elmalar" (*μήλο* kelimesinin çoğulu), [[οι τυρόπιτες]] "peynirli börekler" (*τυρόπιτα* kelimesinin çoğulu).
blocks.en: A few new words: [[η Χαλκιδική]] the peninsula near Thessaloniki, [[το ιατρείο]] "doctor's office", [[η γραμματέας]] "secretary", [[το αυτοκίνητο]] "car", [[τώρα]] "now", [[τα μήλα]] "apples" (the plural of *μήλο*), [[οι τυρόπιτες]] "cheese pies" (the plural of *τυρόπιτα*).

blocks.tr:
Bir Yunanca fiilin çoğu zaman **iki kökü** vardır. Şimdiki zamanın kökü: *γράφ-ω*. Tek bir eylemin kökü: *γράψ-ω*. Gelecek zamanı ikincisiyle kurarsın: **θα + kök + şimdiki zamanın sonları**. *Θα γράψω* "(bir kez) yazacağım" demek: bir e-postayı, bir mektubu.

**θα** hiç değişmez; kişiyi sondaki ek gösterir: θα γράψω, θα γράψεις, θα γράψει, θα γράψουμε, θα γράψετε, θα γράψουν.

Kökü değiştirmek için bazı kalıplar yardım eder (tabloya bak), ama bunlar bir kanun değil: **kökü her fiille birlikte öğren**. Olumsuz için **δεν**, *θα* sözcüğünden önce gelir: [[Δεν θα έρθω.]] "Gelmeyeceğim." *θα* + şimdiki zaman (*θα γράφω*) da vardır; sürekli ya da tekrarlanan bir eylem için kullanılır. Şimdilik onu çalışmıyoruz.
blocks.en:
A Greek verb often has **two stems**. The stem of the present: *γράφ-ω*. The stem for one single action: *γράψ-ω*. You make the future with the second: **θα + stem + the present's endings**. *Θα γράψω* means "I will write (it)": one e-mail, one letter.

**θα** never changes; the ending shows the person: θα γράψω, θα γράψεις, θα γράψει, θα γράψουμε, θα γράψετε, θα γράψουν.

Some patterns help you find the stem (see the table), but they are not a law: **learn the stem with each verb**. For "not", **δεν** goes before *θα*: [[Δεν θα έρθω.]] "I won't come." *θα* + the present form (*θα γράφω*) also exists, for something ongoing or repeated. We do not practise it now.

note.tr: Bunlar kanun değil: μαθαίνω → θα μάθω, καταλαβαίνω → θα καταλάβω (-νω → -σω değil). θα είμαι ve θα έχω değişmez; θα θέλω, θα ξέρω, θα κάνω da öyle.
note.en: These are not a law: μαθαίνω → θα μάθω, καταλαβαίνω → θα καταλάβω (not -νω → -σω). θα είμαι and θα έχω do not change; neither do θα θέλω, θα ξέρω, θα κάνω.

items.en: I'll buy bread at the bakery.

items.el: Θα διαβάσω την εφημερίδα το πρωί.
items.en: I'll read the paper in the morning.

items.el: Την επόμενη εβδομάδα θα ταξιδέψω στη Σμύρνη.
items.en: Next week I'll travel to Izmir.

items.el: Ο Γιώργος θα δουλέψει το Σαββατοκύριακο.
items.en: Giorgos will work at the weekend.

blocks.tr: Bazı çok sık fiillerin gelecek kökü şimdiki zamana hiç benzemez: *τρώω* → *θα φάω*. Bunlar kısa ve çok kullanılır; olduğu gibi ezberle. Sonlar yine aynı: -ω, -εις, -ει, -ουμε, -ετε, -ουν. Yalnız "biz" biçimine dikkat: kısa fiillerde son vurgulu olur (θα δούμε, θα πούμε, θα βρούμε, θα μπούμε, θα βγούμε, θα πιούμε). *θα πάμε* ve *θα φάμε* ise ayrı.
blocks.en: Some very common verbs have a future stem that looks nothing like the present: *τρώω* → *θα φάω*. They are short and frequent: learn them as they are. The endings are the same: -ω, -εις, -ει, -ουμε, -ετε, -ουν. Just watch "we": in the short verbs the ending is stressed (θα δούμε, θα πούμε, θα βρούμε, θα μπούμε, θα βγούμε, θα πιούμε). *θα πάμε* and *θα φάμε* are different.

note.tr: Üçüncü kişiler: θα πάει / θα πάνε, θα έρθει / θα έρθουν, θα φάει / θα φάνε, θα δει, θα βρει.
note.en: Third persons: θα πάει / θα πάνε, θα έρθει / θα έρθουν, θα φάει / θα φάνε, θα δει, θα βρει.

items.el: Θα δω τον γιατρό τη Δευτέρα.
items.en: I'll see the doctor on Monday.
We'll go out together in the evening.

items.el: Θα μείνω στο σπίτι το Σαββατοκύριακο.
items.en: I'll stay at home at the weekend.

blocks.tr:
**θέλω να** "istiyorum" ve **μπορώ να** "yapabilirim" sözlerinden sonra aynı biçim gelir: gelecekteki kök, ama **θα olmadan**. *Θέλω να πάω* "gitmek istiyorum". Yunancada "-mek / -mak" biçimi yok; ikinci fiil de kişiye göre çekilir: θέλω να πάω, θέλεις να πας, θέλουμε να πάμε.

**μπορώ** yeni bir kelime. [[Τηλεφωνώ]] ve [[ευχαριστώ]] gibi **-ώ** ile biter ve sonları onlar gibidir.
blocks.en:
After **θέλω να** "I want" and **μπορώ να** "I can" comes the same form: the future stem, but **without θα**. *Θέλω να πάω* "I want to go". Greek has no "to go" form here; the second verb is also changed for the person: θέλω να πάω, θέλεις να πας, θέλουμε να πάμε.

**μπορώ** is a new word. It ends in **-ώ** like [[τηλεφωνώ]] and [[ευχαριστώ]], and its endings are the same as theirs.

items.en: I want to go to the sea.
Would you like to come along?

items.el: Δεν μπορώ να έρθω το Σάββατο.

blocks.tr: **θα ≈ -ecek / -acak.** Türkçede *yaz-acağ-ım* dersin; Yunancada *θα γράψω*. İki dilde de fiil kişiyi gösterir, bu yüzden *εγώ* demen gerekmez. Fark şu: Yunancada gelecek zaman için ayrı bir ek yok, **θα** ayrı bir sözcüktür ve **kök de değişir** (γράφω → γράψω). Türkçe bunu yapmaz.
blocks.en: **θα works like English “will”.** It is one little word before the verb, and it never changes. The difference from English: the verb itself changes too, because the future uses the other stem (γράφω → γράψω). And as in Spanish or Italian, the ending shows the person, so you can leave out *εγώ*.

blocks.tr: **θα πάω, θα πηγαίνω değil.** Tek bir gezi için [[θα πάω]] ve [[θα έρθω]] de. *θα πηγαίνω* ve *θα έρχομαι* sürekli ya da tekrarlanan bir şey anlatır ("gidiyor olacağım", "düzenli gelirim"). "Cumartesi geleceğim" gibi bir randevu için doğru olan *θα έρθω*.
blocks.en: **θα πάω, not θα πηγαίνω.** For one single trip say [[θα πάω]] and [[θα έρθω]]. *θα πηγαίνω* and *θα έρχομαι* describe something ongoing or repeated ("I'll be going", "I'll keep coming"). For an appointment like "I'll come on Saturday" the right form is *θα έρθω*.

blocks.tr: A2 sözlü sınavındaki rol yapma bölümünde bir buluşma ya da randevu ayarlaman istenebilir. Zeynep'in telefon konuşması tam bu iş için bir model: gün ve saat söyle, "gelebilir misin?" diye sor, uygun değilse başka bir zaman öner. Kalıplar: *Μπορώ να έρθω …; Μπορείς να έρθεις …; Θα έρθω στις …; Δεν μπορώ να έρθω …*
blocks.en: The A2 speaking role-play may ask you to arrange a meeting or an appointment. Zeynep's call is the model: give a day and a time, ask "can you come?", suggest another time. Frames: *Μπορώ να έρθω …; Μπορείς να έρθεις …; Θα έρθω στις …; Δεν μπορώ να έρθω …*

blocks.tr: Şimdi sen dene. Yanlış yapmak serbest: bunlar sınav hazırlığı hesabına girmez.
blocks.en: Now you try. Mistakes are fine here: these do not count towards your exam readiness.
